blocks.value: A switch statement tests one variable against a list of possible values (each called a case) and runs the matching block. The variable can only be an int, byte, short, char, or String.

When the switch value matches a case, execution starts there and continues until it hits a break, which exits the switch. If a case has no break, execution falls through into the next case. default (optional, placed last) runs when nothing else matches, and doesn't need its own break.
